headline: Dua Associates advises Piramal Finance on ₹125 crore financing for residential projects in Bengaluru

detail: Piramal Finance Limited has sanctioned finances aggregating to ₹125 crore for two residential group housing projects in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The transactions involved financing of ₹80 crore to Akarsh Dwellings Private Limited for its residential project, Adarsh Primrose, and ₹45 crore to Adarsh Developers for its project, Adarsh Stratuss. Dua Associates advised Piramal Finance on these financing transactions. The transaction team consisted Prateek Bedi (Partner), Angad Varma (Partner), Rahul Goyal (Partner), Bhaskar Mishra (Partner), Prashant Kumar (Partner), Vaibhav Tripathi (Senior Associate) and Pushkar Athreyas (Associate).
